cases.dictionary_meaning: Nonbeing, absence, or the state of there being nothing.
cases.nuance: Treats absence itself as a substantive notion.
cases.register: Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

cases.dictionary_meaning: The totality of the cosmos, often used as a pair for the whole natural world.
cases.nuance: A paired cosmic expression, not simply two separate nouns in this usage.
cases.register: Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cases.retained_context: 無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。
cases.retained_context_translation: Without name, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.

cases.dictionary_meaning: A genitive or attributive particle linking one noun to another, marking possession, relation, or modification.
cases.nuance: Here it links a noun to the head noun that follows, without carrying independent lexical content.
cases.register: Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cases.retained_context: 無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。
cases.retained_context_translation: Without name, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.

cases.dictionary_meaning: A third-person pronoun referring to a previously mentioned or contextually understood person or thing.
cases.nuance: Often used as an object pronoun or after certain verbs and prepositions.
cases.register: Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
